Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL4973 (Excitatory amino acid transporter 2). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, and assays to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL4973, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
